shellCommands.command: ls -R /workspace/app /workspace/__agent_eval__ 2>/dev/null | head -50; echo ---; cat /workspace/tsconfig.json; echo ---; cat /workspace/next.config.ts

grep -rln "PROXY_FILENAME" node_modules/next/dist/build/ node_modules/next/dist/server/ 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== deprecation msgs ==="; grep -rn "deprecated" node_modules/next/dist/build/index.js 2>/dev/null | grep -i "middleware\|proxy" | head

grep -rn "proxy\|middleware" node_modules/next/dist/build/analysis/get-page-static-info.js | grep -i "export\|default\|handler" | head -20; echo "=== types ==="; grep -rn "ProxyConfig\|NextProxy\|export type\|export declare" node_modules/next/types/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | grep -i proxy | head
cat node_modules/next/server.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "=== grep proxy types ==="; grep -rn "Proxy" node_modules/next/dist/server/web/exports/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; echo "--- / ---"; curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null http://localhost:3111/ | grep -i "^HTTP\|x-request-id"; echo "--- / again ---"; curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null http://localhost:3111/ | grep -i "x-request-id"; echo "--- /some/nested/path ---"; curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null http://localhost:3111/some/nested/path | grep -i "^HTTP\|x-request-id"
grep -v "^ *$" /tmp/next.log | tail -12; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; echo "(server stopped)"
git status --short && echo "--- tsconfig include ---" && grep -n "include" tsconfig.json && echo "--- gitignore ---" && cat .gitignore
git diff tsconfig.json; rm -rf /workspace/.next /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; echo "(removed build artifacts)"; git status --short
